hook.text: A champion racehorse can be worth $200 million. Equine insurance protects owners against death, injury, and infertility.

buildup.text: Stallions earn millions in stud fees after racing. Infertility insurance protects the post-racing income stream.

discovery.text: Lloyd's of London is the world's largest equine insurer. They've covered racehorses since the industry began.

twist.text: Some owners have murdered insured horses to collect payouts.

climax.text: Equine insurance shows that wherever large sums protect living creatures, fraud follows.

punchline.text: $200 million horse, massive premiums. Where there's value, there's fraud.

quiz.question: What income stream does equine infertility insurance protect?
